A '''pulse hammer''' was an industrial tool. [[Gallorr's Light Repair Shed]] was equipped with a pulse hammer, which [[Arno Gallorr]] used to pound dents out of large blades used to extract [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>
